Sub: Avoiding duplicate entry in Legal Dashboard - regarding

Sir

Kindly refer to Head Office email dated 29.12.2015, circulating the minutes of the
meeting taken by ACC(HQ), RB, on the issue of Legal Dashboard. Attention is invited to
point No. 7(v) of the said minutes, wherein instructions on the captioned subject are

recorded.

2 In this regard, it is again clarified that the office whose impugned order is
challenged in any court shall remain the primary office to deal with that case at all levels
(i.e upto Supreme Court) and shall be solely responsible to make entries in Legal
Dashboard with respect to that case. If any other office (including Head Office, Ministry,
etc.) are also parties to that case, then the Nodal Officers of those Respondent offices
shall ensure initiation of necessary action of replying or defending the case on part of
those Respondent Offices. Hence, the Nodal Officers should regularly run the queries
and Reports in Legal Dashboard to find out the cases where their office has been made

the Respondent.

3 It is clarified no office other than the one whose order/action has been primarily

challenged in the Court shall make the entry in Legal Dashboard. Even if the case goes

up in appeal to any court outside its territorial jurisdiction, it will keep updating the

case in Legal Dashboard.

5 Two illustrations are hereby given for clear understanding:-
IDS* prepared by SRO Jallandhar ==> PPO issued by RO Trivandrum
— => Pension challenged in Kerala HC => Appeal filed in Supreme Court,
where CPFC, RPFC Trivandrum and RPFC Tirunelveli are the Respondents.

(*IDS = Input Data Sheet for Pension)

Procedure for entering the case in Legal Dashboard and follow-up:

i)

(ii)

(iii)

Entry in Legal Dashboard will be made by Nodal Officer of RO Trivandrum and
all subsequent updates upto the level of Supreme Court will be done by the
Nodal Officer of RO Trivandrum.

Nodal Officer of SRO Jallandhar will initiate necessary action on behalf of
Respondent RPFC Jallandhar, on the basis of information available in Legal
Dashboard.

Legal Cell at Head Office will initiate necessary action on behalf of Respondent
CPFC/Uol, on the basis of information available in Legal Dashboard, subject to
para-3 of the Head Office Circular LC/4(96)2015/MP HC/24933 dated
09/11.09.2015 (at S.No. 371 for the year 2015-16 of official website). The
contents of the said para are reproduced below for quick reference:

Accordingly, all field offices are advised to take necessary action at their own level
in the cases where CPFC/UOI are proforma respondents as per instructions of Head
Office and not send draft counter replies to Head Office for approval and vetting to
avoid delay in submission of counter replies before Hon'ble court.

Thus, it will be the responsibility of the Nodal Officer of RO Trivandrum to enter
the names of all Respondents (EPFO and its officers/ Uol and its officers)
promptly in the Legal Dashbaord. After that, it will be the responsibility of the
concerned office to put up the matter to the Respondent Officer for his

information.

.
\

Illustration 2:-

Recovery Certificate issued by Authorized Officer of RO Faridabad =>
Recovery Certificate transferred to Recovery Officer of RO Jaipur =—>
Recovery action of the Recovery Officer of RO Jaipur is challenged in Jaipur HC.
where RPFC Jaipur and RPFC Faridabad are the Respondents.

Procedure for entering the case in Legal Dashboard and follow-up:
(i) Entry in Legal Dashboard will be made by the Nodal Officer of RO Jaipur and all

subsequent updates upto the level of Supreme Court will be done by the Nodal
Officer of RO Jaipur.

(ii) Nodal Officer of RO Faridabad will initiate necessary action on behalf of
Respondent RPFC Faridabad, on the basis of information available in Legal
Dashboard.

6 It is requested to follow the above directions to avoid duplicate entry of cases in
Legal Dashboard. The OICs and Nodal Officers of the primary office (for example RO
Jaipur and RO Trivandrum in the above illustrations) will coordinate with other
respondents through email to ensure that other Respondents are aware of their role in

the case.

. Yours faithfully
